articles.summary: ISSAQUAH, Wash., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today reported net sales of $24.50 billion for the retail month of October, the four weeks ended November 1, 2026, an increase of 12.6 percent from $21.75 billion last year. Net sales for the first nine weeks were $54.52 billion, an increase of 12.8 percent from $48.33 billion last year. articles.summary: ISSAQUAH, Wash., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share on Costco common stock. It is payable December 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 24, 2026. The total amount of the payment will be approximately $13.3 billion. The Company also announced that the Board has reauthorized a common-stock repurchase program of up to $4 billion. This program will expire in November 2030 and replaces the current $4 billion program (adopted in 2023 and scheduled to expire January 2027), under which $3.1 billion had been purchased.
